description: The import logs of this tenant: counts per run and, with run_id, the per-row outcome including the reason for every rejection and every suggestion. Also lists contract imports (import_contract_from_folder, kind='contract_import'): each run's state (running/complete/failed) and, with its run_id, the per-file progress and result (contract_id / reason).

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

outcome.description: Only rows with this outcome (with run_id)

name: list_import_runs
